regions.merged_text: God bless you and keep you well. - you and yours. I'd like to write you a real letter but this is just to thank you for crate of fine oranges received here in excellent condition a few days back. They are very good. - in fact I think the best yet. How wonderful is the dear Lord in all His works!

regions.merged_text: God bless you Josph O'Donnell - you and yours. I was in hopes to catch up with my correspondence and then write you, but it seems the letters come faster and faster so that I have to keep right on the job; and the longer I wait the more what's not too urgent gets snowed under. At all events I want to say at least thank you for the big crate of fine Grape-fruit. Nony thanks indeed. ^You can see for yourself. this is hardly an expert an underwood.
